title: MZ ARPG Plugin Error on RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: Shadowbluum
posts.body: I have been at trying to figure out this error for a while. I'm doing things for the most part by how the plugin documents say to do it while trying to work around the plugins I already have. It's jokes on me mostly for changing the combat halfway through developing my game, but it is saying Unknown Type [object OBJECT] I need help if anyone has used this plugin set. My game won't even load so I know it has to do with the plugin files themselves from where I've been trying to set them up.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Did you google that error in the ARPG plugin and check what solutions people have found? In some thread someone said they had some map listed in the plugin settings that didn't exist in their project. Also, with that plugin I remember it caused errors if you didn't go into the plugin settings and click inside some spots so that 0 turned to 0.00. At least that used to be the case, but don't know if it would cause that error. Most people start with the demo project and build from that.
